title: fix(listen): join the forwarding URL path and the event path with a single slash

@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+// Package forwardurl builds the URL that `hookdeck listen` forwards an event
+// to. The request and every place that prints the URL share it, so what the
+// CLI shows is what the CLI sent.
+package forwardurl
+
+import (
+	"net/url"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// JoinPath appends the event's path to the forwarding URL's path with a single
+// "/" between them. A trailing "/" on the forwarding URL is dropped only when
+// the event path starts with one, and the event path itself is left as is: a
+// receiver may route on its own trailing slash, which is why path.Join is not
+// used.
+//
+// When the forwarding URL has no path, the event path is appended straight
+// after the host, so an event path that does not start with "/", "?" or "#"
+// would be read as part of the host. It gets a "/" in front instead.
+func JoinPath(base, eventPath string) string {
+	if base == "" && eventPath != "" && !strings.ContainsRune("/?#", rune(eventPath[0])) {
+		eventPath = "/" + eventPath
+	}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(eventPath, "/") {
+		base = strings.TrimSuffix(base, "/")
+	}
+	return base + eventPath
+}
+
+// Build returns the full URL for an event: the forwarding URL's scheme, host
+// and path, then the event's path.
+func Build(target *url.URL, eventPath string) string {
+	return target.Scheme + "://" + target.Host + JoinPath(target.Path, eventPath)
+}

+package forwardurl
+
+import (
+	"net/url"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestBuild(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name      string
+		target    string
+		eventPath string
+		want      string
+	}{
+		{"forwarding URL with a trailing slash", "http://localhost:3000/base/", "/webhook", "http://localhost:3000/base/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL without a trailing slash", "http://localhost:3000/base", "/webhook", "http://localhost:3000/base/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL is the root", "http://localhost:3000/", "/webhook", "http://localhost:3000/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL has no path", "http://localhost:3000", "/webhook", "http://localhost:3000/webhook"},
+		{"event path keeps its own trailing slash", "http://localhost:3000/base/", "/webhook/", "http://localhost:3000/base/webhook/"},
+		{"event path is empty", "http://localhost:3000/base/", "", "http://localhost:3000/base/"},
+		{"no forwarding path and an event path without a leading slash", "http://localhost:3000", "webhook", "http://localhost:3000/webhook"},
+		{"no forwarding path and an event path that is only a query", "http://localhost:3000", "?a=b", "http://localhost:3000?a=b"},
+		{"no forwarding path and an event path that is only a fragment", "http://localhost:3000", "#frag", "http://localhost:3000#frag"},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			target, err := url.Parse(tt.target)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, Build(target, tt.eventPath))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// With no path on the forwarding URL the event path follows the host directly,
+// so an event path that does not begin with "/" must not be able to turn into
+// part of the host or into user information. The URL has to parse back to the
+// host the user asked to forward to.
+func TestBuildKeepsTheForwardingHost(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, eventPath := range []string{
+		"@other.example",
+		"@other.example/x",
+		":8080/x",
+		".other.example",
+		"other.example",
+		"/@other.example",
+		"//other.example/x",
+		"/../x",
+		"%2f%2fother.example",
+	} {
+		for _, forwardTo := range []string{"http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:3000/", "http://localhost:3000/base"} {
+			t.Run(forwardTo+" "+eventPath, func(t *testing.T) {
+				target, err := url.Parse(forwardTo)
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+
+				built, err := url.Parse(Build(target, eventPath))
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+
+				assert.Equal(t, "localhost:3000", built.Host)
+				assert.Nil(t, built.User)
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}

+package listen
+
+import (
+	"net/url"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/hookdeck/hookdeck-cli/pkg/hookdeck"
+)
+
+// The startup banner lists "Forwards to → <URL>" for each connection. It has to
+// show the URL the events will be forwarded to, including the forwarding URL's
+// path, joined to the connection's path with a single "/".
+func TestCompactBannerForwardsToJoinsForwardingURLAndConnectionPath(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name      string
+		forwardTo string
+		cliPath   string
+		want      string
+	}{
+		{"trailing slash on the forwarding URL", "http://localhost:3030/base/", "/webhook", "Forwards to → http://localhost:3030/base/webhook"},
+		{"no trailing slash on the forwarding URL", "http://localhost:3030/base", "/webhook", "Forwards to → http://localhost:3030/base/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL has no path", "http://localhost:3030", "/webhook", "Forwards to → http://localhost:3030/webhook"},
+		{"connection path is the default root", "http://localhost:3030/base/", "/", "Forwards to → http://localhost:3030/base/"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			resetColorState(t)
+			cfg, sources, connections, _ := printerFixture(t, 1)
+			targetURL, err := url.Parse(tc.forwardTo)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			connections[0].Destination = &hookdeck.Destination{
+				ID: "des_1", Type: "CLI", Config: map[string]interface{}{"path": tc.cliPath},
+			}
+
+			out := capturePrinterOutput(t, func() {
+				printSourcesWithConnections(cfg, "tm_1", sources, connections, targetURL, "")
+			})
+
+			assert.Contains(t, out, tc.want)
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestProcessAttemptJoinsForwardingURLPathAndEventPath(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name       string
+		forwardTo  string
+		eventPath  string
+		expectPath string
+	}{
+		{"forwarding URL with a trailing slash", "/base/", "/webhook", "/base/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL without a trailing slash", "/base", "/webhook", "/base/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL is the root", "/", "/webhook", "/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL has no path", "", "/webhook", "/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL has no path and the event path has no leading slash", "", "@other.example/x", "/@other.example/x"},
+		{"event path keeps its own trailing slash", "/base/", "/webhook/", "/base/webhook/"},
+		{"event path is empty", "/base/", "", "/base/"},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			received := make(chan string, 1)
+			local := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+				received <- r.URL.Path
+				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+			}))
+			t.Cleanup(local.Close)
+
+			target, err := url.Parse(local.URL + tt.forwardTo)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			p := New(&Config{URL: target, NoHealthcheck: true}, nil, newRecordingRenderer())

+			p.processAttempt(websocket.IncomingMessage{Attempt: &websocket.Attempt{
+				Body: websocket.AttemptBody{
+					Path:      tt.eventPath,
+					EventID:   "evt_test",
+					AttemptId: "evt_test",
+					Request:   websocket.AttemptRequest{Method: http.MethodPost, DataString: "{}", Headers: json.RawMessage(`{}`)},
+				},
+			}})
+
+			select {
+			case got := <-received:
+				assert.Equal(t, tt.expectPath, got)
+			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
+				t.Fatal("local server never received the request")
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+package proxy
+
+import (
+	"net/url"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/hookdeck/hookdeck-cli/pkg/listen/tui"
+	"github.com/hookdeck/hookdeck-cli/pkg/websocket"
+)
+
+// The request is sent to a URL built in processAttempt, and each renderer
+// prints the URL it believes was requested. These tests pin both renderers to
+// the single-slash join, so a forwarding URL ending in "/" does not print
+// "/base//webhook" for a request that went to "/base/webhook".
+
+func forwardPathRendererConfig(t *testing.T, forwardTo string) *RendererConfig {
+	t.Helper()
+	cfg := linksRendererConfig(t, "gateway")
+	target, err := url.Parse(forwardTo)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cfg.TargetURL = target
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func forwardPathAttempt(eventPath string) *websocket.Attempt {
+	return &websocket.Attempt{Body: websocket.AttemptBody{
+		Path:         eventPath,
+		EventID:      "evt_1",
+		AttemptId:    "atm_1",
+		ConnectionId: "web_1",
+		Request:      websocket.AttemptRequest{Method: "POST"},
+	}}
+}
+
+var forwardPathRendererCases = []struct {
+	name      string
+	forwardTo string
+	eventPath string
+	want      string
+}{
+	{"trailing slash on the forwarding URL", "http://localhost:3000/base/", "/webhook", "POST http://localhost:3000/base/webhook "},
+	{"no trailing slash on the forwarding URL", "http://localhost:3000/base", "/webhook", "POST http://localhost:3000/base/webhook "},
+	{"forwarding URL is the root", "http://localhost:3000/", "/webhook", "POST http://localhost:3000/webhook "},
+	{"event path keeps its own trailing slash", "http://localhost:3000/base/", "/webhook/", "POST http://localhost:3000/base/webhook/ "},
+}
+
+func TestSimpleRendererJoinsForwardingURLAndEventPath(t *testing.T) {
+	response := &EventResponse{StatusCode: 200, Duration: 5 * time.Millisecond}
+
+	for _, tc := range forwardPathRendererCases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			r := NewSimpleRenderer(forwardPathRendererConfig(t, tc.forwardTo), false)
+			out := captureStdout(t, func() {
+				r.OnEventComplete("evt_1", forwardPathAttempt(tc.eventPath), response, time.Now())
+			})
+			assert.Contains(t, out, tc.want)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestInteractiveRendererJoinsForwardingURLAndEventPath(t *testing.T) {
+	response := &EventResponse{StatusCode: 200, Duration: 5 * time.Millisecond}
+
+	for _, tc := range forwardPathRendererCases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			r, sent := recordingInteractiveRenderer()
+			r.cfg = forwardPathRendererConfig(t, tc.forwardTo)
+
+			r.OnEventComplete("evt_1", forwardPathAttempt(tc.eventPath), response, time.Now())
+
+			require.Len(t, *sent, 1)
+			update, ok := (*sent)[0].(tui.UpdateEventMsg)
+			require.True(t, ok, "unexpected message %T", (*sent)[0])
+			assert.Contains(t, update.LogLine, tc.want)
+		})
+	}
+}

+package tui
+
+import (
+	"net/url"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/hookdeck/hookdeck-cli/pkg/hookdeck"
+	"github.com/hookdeck/hookdeck-cli/pkg/websocket"
+)
+
+// The TUI prints the forwarded URL in two places, and both used to leave the
+// forwarding URL's path out or join it with a doubled "/".
+
+// The request line in the event details (and the copied request) is the URL the
+// event was forwarded to.
+func TestEventDetailsRequestLineJoinsForwardingURLAndEventPath(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name      string
+		forwardTo string
+		eventPath string
+		want      string
+	}{
+		{"trailing slash on the forwarding URL", "http://localhost:3500/base/", "/webhook", "POST http://localhost:3500/base/webhook"},
+		{"no trailing slash on the forwarding URL", "http://localhost:3500/base", "/webhook", "POST http://localhost:3500/base/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL is the root", "http://localhost:3500/", "/webhook", "POST http://localhost:3500/webhook"},
+		{"event path keeps its own trailing slash", "http://localhost:3500/base/", "/webhook/", "POST http://localhost:3500/base/webhook/"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			m := newDetailsTestModel(t)
+			target, err := url.Parse(tc.forwardTo)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			m.cfg.TargetURL = target
+
+			event := &EventInfo{
+				ID: "evt_test",
+				Data: &websocket.Attempt{Body: websocket.AttemptBody{
+					Path:    tc.eventPath,
+					Request: websocket.AttemptRequest{Method: "POST", DataString: "{}"},
+				}},
+			}
+
+			content, copyContent := m.buildEventDetailsContent(event)
+
+			assert.Equal(t, tc.want, copyContent.requestLine)
+			assert.Contains(t, content, tc.want)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// The header lists each connection under its source as "Forwards to → <URL>".
+func TestConnectionInfoForwardsToJoinsForwardingURLAndConnectionPath(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name      string
+		forwardTo string
+		cliPath   string
+		want      string
+	}{
+		{"trailing slash on the forwarding URL", "http://localhost:3030/base/", "/webhook", "Forwards to → http://localhost:3030/base/webhook"},
+		{"no trailing slash on the forwarding URL", "http://localhost:3030/base", "/webhook", "Forwards to → http://localhost:3030/base/webhook"},
+		{"forwarding URL has no path", "http://localhost:3030", "/webhook", "Forwards to → http://localhost:3030/webhook"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			m := newConnectionTestModel(t)
+			target, err := url.Parse(tc.forwardTo)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			m.cfg.TargetURL = target
+			m.cfg.Connections[0].Destination = &hookdeck.Destination{
+				ID: "des_1", Type: "CLI", Config: map[string]interface{}{"path": tc.cliPath},
+			}
+
+			assert.Contains(t, m.renderConnectionInfo(), tc.want)
+		})
+	}
+}
